name: dsh-startup-cyrene
description: Cyrene-style startup splash for DeepSeek Harness: plays a configurable list of local video segments at boot, lets a click jump ahead, then fades into the workbench. User media live in ~/.dsh/startup-cyrene-media so plugin updates never overwrite them.

scripts.test: node test/splash-script.test.mjs && node test/plugin-apply.test.mjs && node test/config.test.mjs
